grammar.summary: 本课学习 be willing to 与鬼屋叙事的时态配合。

points.title: be willing to do
points.explanation: 愿意做某事：Mr. Thompson was willing to sell it. willingness 名词形式也常见。

examples.en: Mr. Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
examples.cn: Thompson 先生打算卖掉它，因为它闹鬼。

points.title: be told / hear 表"听说"的被动信息源
points.explanation: He told me that... 引语结构 + was going to 过去将来时态。

examples.en: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub.
examples.cn: 村民们告诉他他们不会接受这酒馆。
